verdict.rationale: Exporting your entity's filing records is a fair question for a corporate registry, so the axis applies. The pack, however, documents no self-service export of an entity's data in open formats and nothing about leaving (converting or transferring out). The closest item is the paid Long Form Certificate of Status, a certificate returned by mail that lists filings; it is an adjacent document request, not a data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
